title: Why suddenly I lost my Market Data Subscription?
text: I have been paid Monthly $7 to subscribe Alpaca Market Data for a long time, recently I opened my IRA account and transferred more than $100K into it, suddenly my paid Market Data feed got Subscription Error : net.jacobpeterson.alpaca.model.endpoint.marketdata.common.realtime.control.ErrorMessage@5869e26c[messageType=error,code=409,message=insufficient subscription I use my IRA account keys, same error!!! WHY and HOW do I get my Market Data feed back? NEED HELP ASAP!!! Still no update ticket #369671 1 post - 1 participant Read full topic
triage_reason: Trader lost their paid market data subscription unexpectedly after account transfer.
